title: Equal query probabilities after symmetrization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube whose symmetries act transitively on the coordinates, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree computing $f$ with sign-valued inputs and outputs. For any probability distribution $pi$ on the sign alphabet, the symmetrized tree has the same query probability at every coordinate under the independent product input distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
For every pair of coordinates there is a coordinate permutation carrying the first to the second and preserving $f$
$T$ computes $f$ and has sign-valued inputs and outputs
$T$ has a finite nonempty seed space and seed probability law
$pi$ is a probability distribution on the sign alphabet
